{
  "opening_spine": {
    "pressure_source_type": "relational",
    "pressure_source": "Seren is abandoning the rehearsed wish in front of the whole assembly, redirecting her First Sacrifice to Lirael instead, and the presiding Dohkar is about to call out the misalignment",
    "hook_object": null,
    "opening_beat": "Seren’s voice falters mid-invocation, her fingers tightening around the ceremonial sash as she glances at Lirael instead of the assembled First Favored",
    "rising_beats": [
      "The presiding Dohkar’s gaze sharpens on Seren’s hesitation, his posture shifting slightly as if to correct her",
      "Julian’s stillness at the edge of the gathering becomes a weight, his attention locked on Lirael’s muffled tension"
    ],
    "decision_beat": "Should she rip the band from her mouth and name the misalignment herself, or let Seren’s unspoken wish twist further?",
    "pc_career": "Sacrificiant apprentice",
    "opening_setting": "Veilwood ceremony clearing",
    "environment_elements": [
      "the frayed edge of the deep-crimson spiralgrass carpet where Seren’s bare feet have pressed",
      "the pale mated-pair trees’ leaf-curtains trembling in the dawn breeze"
    ],
    "interlocutor_placement": "Seren — the youth making her First Sacrifice, her hands trembling as she clutches the ceremonial sash, her breath uneven like she’s about to run",
    "pc_self_presentation_beat": "She adjusts the muffling band across her mouth with deliberate slowness, her fingers brushing the ornate sash beneath it — the one Julian had once said made her look like a queen who’d forgotten her crown",
    "scene_want": "Wants Seren to name the wound aloud so she can stop feeling the cost of it as her own",
    "scene_mission": "Stop Seren’s wish from twisting before the presiding Dohkar calls for the cost to be spoken",
    "reader_state": {
      "knows": "Seren is abandoning her rehearsed wish to sacrifice for Lirael instead, and the presiding Dohkar is about to intervene",
      "believes": "The misalignment could unravel the rite entirely, and Lirael’s muffled silence won’t be enough to stop it",
      "wondering": "Why is Julian watching her so intently from the edge of the gathering?",
      "must_not_confuse": "Who is acting (Seren, the Dohkar, Julian), what physical event occurs (the wish’s misalignment, the Dohkar’s correction), why the next action follows (the cost being named)"
    },
    "pc_body_callback": "opening — stress_tic (the grandmother’s ring)",
    "li_body_callback": "beat 2 — focus_tell (the way his gaze lingers on her fingers adjusting the band)",
    "staged_characters": [
      { "name": "Lirael", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_PC_OPENING_FUSION" },
      { "name": "Julian", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "Seren", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" },
      { "name": "the presiding Dohkar", "presence": "IN_PERSON", "anchor_beat": "FROM_CHARACTER_PLUS" }
    ]
  },
  "scene_skeleton": {
    "character_plus": [
      {
        "character": "Seren",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-4",
        "expression_mode": "CONCEAL",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "Seren blurs the wording of her wish, her voice dropping to a murmur as she avoids naming Lirael’s wound aloud",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": [],
        "revelation_bridge": "Her avoidance of direct naming reveals her belief that softening the wound is kinder than making it plain",
        "pc_lens_operation": "INWARD_TRANSLATION_OF_ANOTHER_PERSONS_COST",
        "pc_interpretation": "Seren believes sparing Lirael the direct recognition of her wound is an act of kindness"
      },
      {
        "character": "the presiding Dohkar",
        "mode": "IN_PERSON",
        "option_id": "OPT-8",
        "expression_mode": "CONTRADICT",
        "first_mention": true,
        "visible_action": "The presiding Dohkar’s posture stiffens, his fingers tapping the ceremonial sash as he waits for Seren to correct herself",
        "behavior_object_ids": ["O5"],
        "behavior_person_ids": ["named:seren"],
        "revelation_bridge": "His insistence on protocol contradicts Seren’s unspoken wish, asserting his authority over the rite’s alignment",
        "pc_lens_operation": "PERSONALIZE_SOCIAL_HARM",
        "pc_interpretation": "The Dohkar assumes his judgment carries authority that others haven’t earned, even in Seren’s moment of vulnerability"
      }
    ],
    "environment_plus": {
      "target": "the deep-crimson carpet of braided mated-pair spiralgrass",
      "axis": "use",
      "beat": "the carpet’s braids are worn thin where Seren’s knees have pressed into it, the red threads frayed like the edges of a torn wish"
    },
    "pc_opening_fusion": {
      "character": "Lirael",
      "placement": "PC_FIRST_EMBODIED_BEAT",
      "character_angle": "Her body tenses at the first sign of misalignment, her fingers already reaching for the band across her mouth before she’s consciously decided to stop it",
      "environment_target": "the pale mated-pair trees’ leaf-curtains",
      "environment_axis": "damage",
      "beat": "Lirael’s breath catches as the leaf-curtains tremble, her fingers brushing the frayed edge of the band—just enough to remind herself it’s still there, muffling her"
    }
  }
}
